#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 998244353;
// const int MOD = 1000000007;

ll dp[1005][25][11]; // Adjust size as needed: A.length+1 <= 1005, 25, 11

ll bit1[100005];

unordered_map<int, int> mp;

void fill_dp(long long dp[][25][11], int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 25; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 11; ++k) {
                dp[i][j][k] = -1;
            }
        }
    }
}

ll go(char A[], int i, int pv, int v, int n) {
    if (i == n) {
        return (pv == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (dp[i][pv][v] != -1)
        return dp[i][pv][v];
    ll ans = 0;
    if (A[i] == '_') {
        for (int j = 0; j < 10; ++j) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0)
                continue;
            int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
            ans += go(A, i + 1, y, v, n);
        }
    }
    else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if (v != 10) {
            ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + v) % 25, v, n);
        }
        else {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; ++j) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
                ans += go(A, i + 1, y, j, n);
            }
        }
    }
    else {
        ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + (A[i] - '0')) % 25, v, n);
    }
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int ttt = 1;
    // ttt = i(); // Not used in main; single test case
    while (ttt--) {
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        int n = (int)s.size();
        char A[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) A[i] = s[i];
        A[n] = '\0';

        if (n == 1 && A[0] == '0') {
            cout << "1\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if (A[0] == '0') {
            cout << "0\n";
            return 0;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            if (A[0] == 'X' || A[0] == '_') {
                cout << "1\n";
                return 0;
            }
        }

        fill_dp(dp, n + 1);
        cout << go(A, 0, 0, 10, n) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
